items.title: Minor "Ram" Hall Interview, 1958-09-02
items.q: I heard him play once. Seen him once. But I never, I mean, come in contact or play with him, nothing like that.

ctx.x: I heard him play once. Seen him once. But I never, I mean, come in contact or play with him, nothing like that. Because I didn't do much playing around. All the band I played around in the Orleans was over at the time, and the little band I went down to Cuts and played with, and this job I had was Sidney Bichon off the camel.
